description: Wren, the pale ghost of a small lamp-boy about eight years old, his whole body and clothes pale blue-white and faintly glowing, short messy hair, an oversized patched work smock with rolled sleeves, a rope harness across his chest, a little tin cup at his belt, bare feet, holding one softly glowing feather in his hands
made_with: the PixelLab connector: Pro mode, designed from Wren's sheet (OpenArt pqQCYVREgz4lYxDSVvfa), in the style of character b98d8501-db99-489e-98a1-0242ff26ac06 (Pip); walk from the walking template, battle idle from the idle-breathing template, attack, cast and hurt as custom PixMiniMax animations
state: the PixelLab state "With feather" of character d40d7e5d-2460-42f0-b690-1a06693efe3e, made 27 November 2026 so that he holds the feather in every direction and has solid legs in the side views
walk: the V3 walking action (animation "walk-v3", 8 frames); the south walk is a custom V3 animation ("walk-south-feather") started from the fixed south sprite
fixed_by_hand: the south standing sprite: the feather set in his raised hand, taken from the south-east view
north attack frames 3 and 5: a stray speed line through his head removed
north-west attack: the feather and its trail had turned bright green, put back to the feather's own pale glow
